node.statement: Corrected same-chart reduction and direct definitional closure: choose one chart kappa:U->E with kappa(x)=0 for both source and target. Since f(x)=x and f is continuous, shrink to W subset U with f(W) subset U, and put F=kappa composed with f composed with kappa^{-1}. If S=Dkappa_x, then the chain rule gives DF_0=S(Df_x)S^{-1}, whence I-DF_0=S(I-Df_x)S^{-1} and det(I-DF_0)=det(I-Df_x); the verifier challenge orientation-reversing mixed-chart counterexample is therefore excluded. For the intrinsic conclusion no unregistered coordinate/germ invariance is required: the registered allowed axiom def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data defines the local fixed-point index at a nondegenerate fixed point by ind(f,x)=sgn det(1-Df_x), with Df_x:T_xM->T_xM. The assumed determinant is nonzero, so directly ind(f,x)=sgn det(I-Df_x). Thus the corrected derivation proves node 1 without using the invalid mixed-chart assertions in nodes 1.2.1-1.2.2.
